title: AI features and your website
measures: How AI Overviews and AI Mode use pages: no additional requirements or special optimizations; page must be indexed and eligible to show with a snippet; no new machine-readable files, AI text files or special schema needed; reporting inside the Search Console Performance report 'Web' search type; preview controls (nosnippet, max-snippet, noindex); Google-Extended pointer.
limitations: Google describes AI features may change; inclusion is not assured even when requirements are met.

title: Overview of OpenAI Crawlers
measures: OAI-SearchBot (ChatGPT search results), GPTBot (content that may be used to train foundation models), ChatGPT-User (user-initiated visits; robots.txt rules may not apply; not used to decide Search inclusion), OAI-AdsBot; settings are independent; about 24 hours for search systems to adjust after a robots.txt change; published IP ranges.
limitations: OpenAI may add or rename agents; the page shows no publication date.

title: Creating helpful, reliable, people-first content
measures: Self-assessment questions for people-first content, search-engine-first warning signs, E-E-A-T and YMYL explanation, Who/How/Why framing, warning against deceptive authorship.
limitations: Describes what Google's systems seek to reward in general terms; it is not a ranking formula.

title: Guidelines for representing your business on Google
measures: Eligibility and naming rules for Business Profiles, address and service-area rules, phone and website rules, hours, category selection, chains, and individual practitioner rules (dentists named as practitioners; multiple practitioners at one location; solo practitioners in branded organizations).
limitations: Policy page; Google may change it without notice.

title: Tips to improve your local ranking on Google
measures: Local results are mainly based on relevance, distance and prominence (the page's summary sentence says 'popularity'; the section heading says 'Prominence'); no way to request or pay for better local ranking; prominence uses information such as links and review count and ratings.
limitations: Google keeps algorithm details confidential; factor weights are not published.

title: About primary and secondary conversion actions
measures: Primary conversion actions are used for bidding optimisation and reporting; secondary actions are observed but not used for optimisation.

title: About offline conversion imports
measures: Explains importing offline outcomes using GCLID or call data; recommends enhanced conversions for leads; notes that from June 15, 2026 offline conversion and enhanced conversions for leads uploads move to the Data Manager API.
limitations: Product documentation; migration dates and recommended methods change.

title: About negative keywords
measures: Negative keywords do not match close variants; synonyms and singular or plural forms must be added separately; account-level negative lists exist.

title: About the search terms report
measures: The report lists search terms used by a significant number of people that triggered ads; low-volume terms are omitted for privacy and may be grouped as other queries.
limitations: The report does not show every query the budget paid for.

title: About targeting geographic locations
limitations: Help page; settings names may change.

title: About Ad Scheduling
measures: Campaigns default to All day; schedules limit days and hours and allow bid adjustments; campaigns with ad schedules pace toward 30.4 times the average daily budget per month.

title: About access levels in your Google Ads account
measures: Lists Google Ads access levels (Email-only, Billing, Read-only, Standard, Admin) and what each can do; notes the risk of having only one administrator and that admins of an owning manager account can edit user access.
limitations: Product documentation; access levels may change.

title: Manage your Business Profile owners and managers
measures: Owner and manager roles, single primary owner, transferring primary ownership
limitations: Help page; no visible update date.

title: Managing owners, users, and permissions
measures: Verified owners, delegated owners, full users and restricted users in Search Console; a property needs at least one verified owner.
